messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert auto-fired: PD-INC-83421 - inference-gateway-prod (eu-west1) - 5xx-rate spike (>12% in 1m)
pagerduty: Triggered at 2026-03-15T01:02:47Z. Incident priority: P1. Escalation policy: inference-prod-oncall.
maya (oncall_sre): acked
maya (oncall_sre): I'm on it. Starting triage — checking dashboards and recent deploys. :mag_right:
javier (runtime): saw a small deploy 5m ago to inference-gateway that touched auth-client. Any cfg rollouts? 
maya (oncall_sre): No deploy on gateway in last 30m from CI. But config push to auth service 7m ago (rollout id auth-20260315-3). Checking auth latency.
sam (infra): infra autoscale did a small scale-up but not enough. CPU on gateway pods are normal. Request queueing looks high between gateway and auth-introspect.
elaine (support): customers reporting timeouts in EU; Support ticket count spike +4 in last 10m.
maya (oncall_sre): logs from gateway show repeated 502s with upstream timeout: "token-introspect timeout=1500ms". Attaching curl test.
maya (oncall_sre): ```
$ curl -v 'https://auth-introspect.prod.internal/v1/introspect' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <sample>'
* Connected to auth-introspect (10.2.3.8) port 443
* Timeout was reached
```
javier (runtime): That looks like auth provider is slow. Can we switch gateway to use token cache bypass TTL to reduce calls? There's a feature-flag to increase token-cache TTL to 5m.
maya (oncall_sre): Good idea. Applying emergency flag now via ops-bot.
ops-bot: /ff toggle gateway.token_cache_ttl=300 --scope=prod --reason=\"auth-introspect latency emergency\"
ops-bot: flag applied to inference-gateway-prod. Propagating (~10s).
maya (oncall_sre): Monitoring error rate... error rate down to 8% in 30s :eyes:
sam (infra): Also temporarily routing traffic away from eu-west1 failover slice to eu-central1 for 30% of traffic.
sam (infra): ```
kubectl patch svc gateway -n prod -p '{"spec":{"externalTrafficPolicy":"Local"}}'
# or adjust traffic slice in router console
```
maya (oncall_sre): Good. I'll keep scaling and watch. Can someone confirm auth-introspect health?
javier (runtime): auth team pinged. They see slow DB connection pool exhaustion after config change. They're rolling back auth cfg now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: maya (oncall_sre) acknowledged. Escalation timer paused.
pagerduty: Auto-reminder suppressed.
elaine (support): Notifying customers: posting to status page draft. Will post "partial degradation in EU, mitigation in progress" once we see continuous improvement.
maya (oncall_sre): After flag + routing, 5xx rate stabilized ~2.1% for 3 consecutive 30s windows. Good. Continue to monitor for 15m before closing.
sam (infra): Added temporary extra gateway replica in eu-west1, scaling to +2. Watching connection backlog.
javier (runtime): auth team rolled back config 3m ago. Auth latency back to normal 120ms.
maya (oncall_sre): Confirmed: error rate back to baseline. Updating PD note: mitigation complete, will follow up with postmortem.
pagerduty: Incident PD-INC-83421 acknowledged -> resolved by maya (oncall_sre). Incident duration: 13m.
maya (oncall_sre): Quick runbook notes: root cause = auth-introspect cfg change causing DB pool exhaustion -> token introspect timeouts -> gateway returned 502s under load. Mitigations: toggle token cache TTL, route traffic away, scale gateway. Postmortem owner: javier.
javier (runtime): I'll take the postmortem, include timeline and recommend better canary and health-check thresholds for auth-introspect.
elaine (support): I'll send customer update and tag impacted customers. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Created follow-up ticket: RD-INC-83421-followup (owner: javier)
maya (oncall_sre): handing off to next oncall for 15m watch. @sam you're primary now.
sam (infra): Ack. Monitoring for any regression. :thumbsup:
